current_implementation_description: selected provider's ordered canonical Information Request set
cutoff_behavior: information_cutoff_ts is bound on the Pack A envelope and each Request lineage.
exact_governing_definition: pack_a_by_provider[provider] contains the provider's parsed information_requests in supplied canonical order; shared_market_state_pack is None; its fingerprint hashes provider plus ordered request identities.
relationship_to_pack_e: Pack E is separately one shared market-state pack; Pack A is not Pack E minus information.
